tagline: A painted Vancouver spring with falling pixel petals and a pocket-sized guide.
rationale: A cherry blossom canopy frames an illustrated Vancouver inlet. Pixel petals drift across the print and respond to a pointer or tap. A bamboo grove shakes to release more petals, and an inlet marker opens a local note. Pip, an original pixel character, introduces the site and connects the visitor to the counsellor and practical details.
name: Under the Blossoms
typography: Locally bundled Manrope and Instrument Serif in roman and italic; word-by-word scroll reveals, oversized editorial headings and a velocity-responsive type ribbon.
mobile: Art crop emphasizes the painted canopy. Tap the opening, bamboo and harbour marker. Navigation and the guide keep the content easy to reach.
supporting: Pip is an optional navigation guide. The Vancouver landscape is a stylized illustration.
trust: A prominent authentic portrait and approved personal details should be supplied before publication.
seo: Keep name, verified designation, services and Vancouver location in visible text. Use descriptive page titles in production.
accessibility: Global pause and reduced-motion preference support; native touch and keyboard scrolling; visible focus; ordinary headings and links; selected states for interaction controls. Final production accessibility testing is still required.
tradeoff: The counsellor’s approved portrait, copy, credentials and contact details are still needed.
